meta.support_definition: fraction of active interface-band nodes (|parent phi| <= 2h) with |dphi| > 10 % of the band maximum (MODE-01)

units.camber: mm; w -> w + a (s^2 - 1/3): + = mid-chord up, edges down (a = mid-minus-edge deflection)
units.corrugation: mm; phi - a cos(2 pi u / 0.1) cos(2 pi y / 0.1) taper (wavelength 4h over the whole band: wide extent, low smoothness; mean ~0)
units.dihedral: mm; zc(y) = zc + a (eta^2 - 1/3), + = tips up
units.offset_s050: mm; as offset_s400 with sigma 0.05 m
units.offset_s125: mm; as offset_s400 with sigma 0.125 m
units.offset_s400: mm; phi - a g taper, g = exp(-((x-xc)^2 + y^2) / (2 sigma^2)), sigma 0.4 m, both surfaces, + = outward (support axis; not neutral)
units.pitch: deg; alpha + a about (xc, zc), + = nose down (higher incidence)
units.reflex: mm; w -> w + a (s^3 - 3s/5): + = trailing edge down, leading edge up
units.sweep: mm; xc(y) = xc + a (eta^2 - 1/3), + = tips downstream
units.thick_chord: e; t (1 + e) with L re-solved for equal section area L t + pi t^2 / 4 (exact volume, flat tips), centre, alpha, y_tip kept; + = thicker and shorter
units.thickness_D0: mm; phi - a (mode01_modes thickness; NOT volume neutral, reference)
units.twist: deg; alpha(y) = alpha + a (eta^2 - 1/3), + = tips nose down relative to mid-span
units.twist_anti: deg; alpha(y) = alpha + a eta (control: mirror-odd)
